base: Production game animation sprite atlas, stylized-concept. Use supplied blue Adam illustration as authoritative character design and photo as facial identity. Create ONE wide 5-column by 1-row sprite sheet, exactly five FULL BODY poses of the SAME four-year-old boy Adam in his cobalt jacket, white shirt, navy shorts, blue sneakers and yellow backpack. Detailed polished illustrated 3D-like rendering, recognizable original face and short black wavy hair, joyful naturally open eyes. Columns left to right: 1 standing relaxed arms slightly out, 2 upward jump arms extended sideways legs slightly bent, 3 falling arms up outward feet reaching downward, 4 landing crouch knees bent arms balancing, 5 victory arms raised smiling. Every character fully contained in its equal-width fifth, same head size and body scale, generous gutters, feet same baseline at 90% image height, centered per cell, no overlap, no cropped hands/hair/shoes. Camera front three-quarter consistent across frames. No text or borders. IMPORTANT background perfectly uniform flat pure magenta RGB(255,0,255) #FF00FF throughout, including gaps between limbs, no shadows or glows on background, NOT transparent or checkerboard. This magenta background is required for game shader keying. No magenta anywhere on clothing. Wide aspect ratio about 3:1, maximum crisp detail.
grid_correction: Edit this five-pose Adam sprite sheet. Preserve character identity, detailed blue outfit, style, and magenta background. Correct the grid packing: exactly five equal width cells with completely empty MAGENTA gutters between them. Make every character narrower by using bent elbows and hands near his shoulders, never arms stretched sideways. Each full-body pose must occupy at most 75% of its cell width. All heads same size and feet aligned at 92% image height, plenty of space above hair. Poses remain standing, jumping up, falling, landing crouch, victory. Keep #FF00FF background absolutely flat, no shadows. No character may enter another column. Render crisp high resolution wide sprite sheet.
